title: Dutch Babies

steps.text: Whisk eggs, milk, flour, sugar & salt in a large bowl until well blended. Let stand at room temp 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 475 and set rack to lowest level. Divide butter between pie pans; place pans in oven until butter melts. Remove pans, swirl butter to coat sides. Divide batter between pans.
Bake pancakes about 12-15 minutes. Pancakes should be set in center, rise high above sides of pan, and be golden color.
Cut into wedges; place on plates. Squeeze lemon juice over top of each; sprinkle with sugar and berries.

notes: Equipment: 2 - 9 or 10" pie pans. Also called Scandinavian Pancakes.
